entities.name: Stanisław Gościniak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanisław Kazimierz Gościniak is a Polish former volleyball player and coach, a member of the Poland national team from 1965 to 1974, and the 1974 World Champion. He was a participant in the 1968 and 1972 Summer Olympics. Gościniak was inducted into the Volleyball Hall of Fame in 2005.
